title: Directory-backed JSON virtual table
description: Implement directory-backed JSON virtual table using .schema.json (x-primaryKey) plus fallback keys (path or path#line). Loader builds an in-memory dataset on startup, optional JSON Schema validation via CLI flag, and exposes columns key/json/source_path/line_no/mtime/size. Duplicate primary keys are fatal errors. Loader mitigates in-flight file changes with stat-read-stat checks, limited retries, and dropping unterminated JSONL tails. Future reloads should swap Arc<Dataset> snapshots.

title: Schema config + CLI flag scaffolding
description: Add schema/config scaffolding for directory-backed JSON tables. Parse .schema.json from the dataset root, read x-primaryKey (JSON Pointer string), and plumb a --validate flag (default off) through main/setup. Define dataset/record metadata structs (key, json bytes, source_path, line_no, mtime, size) and error types for loader failures (missing schema, invalid pointer). No file loading yet beyond schema read.

title: Implement directory loader + dataset build
description: Implement loader that scans dataset root for *.json and *.jsonl (excluding .schema.json) in deterministic path order. For each file, perform stat-read-stat checks with limited retries; if still changing, return fatal error. JSON: parse once, extract key via x-primaryKey or fallback to relative path; JSONL: parse each line, drop trailing unterminated line, key via x-primaryKey or fallback to path#line. On duplicate key, return fatal error with file/line context. When --validate is true, validate against schema before inserting. Build Dataset with records + index.

title: Virtual table over cached dataset
description: Replace constrow with a read-only vtab backed by the in-memory Dataset. Expose columns key, json, source_path, line_no, mtime, size. Implement best_index to support WHERE key = ? (fast path) and full scan otherwise. Choose stable rowid (e.g., hash of key). Wire setup_db to load the dataset at startup and register the module with access to the dataset snapshot.

title: Tests and fixtures for directory loader + vtab
description: Add fixtures under tests/ or a dedicated fixture dir: .schema.json with x-primaryKey, a few .json and .jsonl files. Tests should cover: key extraction (primary + fallback), duplicate key fatal error, JSONL trailing partial line drop, validation flag off vs on (invalid record fails only when --validate), and vtab query path (WHERE key = ? returns expected row, full scan works).
